title: Funnels for Filling Bottles, Wide Mouth Canning Funnel for Kitchen Use Mason Jars, Small Funnel for Transfer Liquid, Oil and Powder, Food Grade Silicone Collapsible Filter Set (3 Pack)
description:
About this item
Food Grade Silicone Funnel: Made of premium quality silicone, our kitchen funnel set is environmentally friendly and 100% food grade safe. Cold and heat resistant from -40℉ up to 482℉, safer and more durable than plastic or metal funnels .
Wide Mouth Canning Funnel：With our multi-purpose large funnel, just put it on bottles or cans, then pouring fresh fruit jars, delicious coffee, sweet candy etc. The 1.65 inches wide mouth is large enough for transferring most food.
3 Different Funnel Sizes: Our Large/ medium/ small funnels set are great for filling bottles, transferring liquids, essential oil, beans, salt, dry ingredients to narrow jars, canning or flasks, adding powdered drink mixes into water bottle. They will meet all filling needs for your family, makes your kitchen and work areas will remain clean and tidy.
Easy To Clean &Store: Collapsible funnel has a foldable feature Occupy less kitchen space after folding and easy to store in any place Convenient for anyone in the family to use. Ultra easy to keep clean even from oil, a simple wash with warm water and add little soap or put it in the dishwasher and let the machine make the job for you.
Satisfaction Guaranteed: Our team is committed to providing every customer with good silicone collapsible funnel and 100% satisfactory service. If there are any problems with our large small funnel set of 3, contact us, we will offer a satisfactory service for you!
reviews_5s:
**⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**

Let’s be honest, who doesn’t love a good *fill-up*? 😉 These funnels are perfect for getting the job done — whether you’re transferring liquids, oils, or even powders. The silicone material feels *luxuriously soft*, but don’t let that fool you. These funnels are tough, durable, and ready to handle all your kitchen needs with ease.

The set comes with three different sizes — small, medium, and large — so you’re covered no matter what you’re filling up. The collapsible design is a *game changer*, making storage a breeze without sacrificing functionality. Plus, the wide-mouth design fits perfectly into mason jars, bottles, and containers, leaving NO mess behind.

It’s like the kitchen equivalent of a well-dressed, well-prepared partner — ready to get *the job done* and leave everything spotless. So, go ahead, fill me up with all those delicious oils, syrups, and spices… because this funnel set is as reliable as it is sexy. 👅love it - use it for wide mouth jars for chicken stew. It keeps your hands from getting burned for soupsEasy to use and store away. Great price.Very niceThey work so good in the kitchen. I make my vanilla extract the small funnel works perfect. they also work super well with canning and feeding your sour dough in a mason jar. Would buy again!!I bought these because I do not feel comfortable using cheap plastic funnels when using hot pack methods for pickles or jellies/jams, etc. when canning. The hot liquids may damage plastic funnels and possibly leaching chemicals. The product description says they will work with boiling hot liquids with no issues. Considering my experiences with other silicone utensils, I will just assume that is true.
I would have preferred metal but I do a lot of acidic foods like pickles or tomatoes and have had issues in the past when using stainless steel utensils for stirring or ladling for example, that imparted a metallic taste to the final product, ruining the food. While it would seem that stainless steel would be inert and would not react with acidic foods after very brief contact, that has not always been my experience. These are made of silicone so that should not be a problem.These are awesome and work great. Definitely worth the money with the different funnel sizes for the different mason jars. Pack away easy as well.These are great. I can pretty much funnel into any container I need to. Six bucks can’t beat itA good purchase. They fold up tight and I hang them on my work area wall for easy access.These are great funnels. They collapse easily and compactly to assist in storage. The three sizes should cover all of your needs.
reviews_1s: I really don't like these - the silicone is sticky for anything dry of viscious, the handles are so heavy that they tip over, and somehow the sizes of the openings seem to be exactly the wrong size for every bottle - they're always exactly the same diameter as the opening for the bottle, and the smaller size is way too small. They're honestly just awful.These don't seem to function at all. I tried to pour a liquid into a bottle and ended up with a mess on the floor. They are flat and don't fit into the receptacle. It really wasn't worth the bother of sending them back, and maybe they will work for something. I still have to find some proper funnels.Disappointed! These funnels have some flaws that make them almost unusable for me. The openings might be designed for Asian and/or European sizes, but they don't fit into my common kitchen containers. I refill my Penzey's spice jars and none of these fit into a common-sized spice bottle. Anything powdery or grainy will stick to the inside of the funnel, causing waste and spillage. The funnel tip is too short to extend far enough into a container. These are stupidly designed and I wish I'd returned them back when I could.Because of the handle (?) or how light weight (?) the funnels are, they won’t sit upright on top of a bottle for filling.
